children: Koil Energy's revenue rose 62% and earnings improved from a year-ago loss, primarily as service work increased $4.9M, led by a large project involving two carousels. Fixed-price project revenue decreased $923K due to the timing of long-term projects ending; a greater share of cost-plus contracts pressured gross margin to 27% from 32%.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Fully diluted”.
: Revenue from service work increased $4.9M, primarily driven by a large project involving two carousels.
: Revenue decreased $923K, attributable to the timing of long-term projects ending.
: Fell to 27% from 32%; a greater share of contracts included significant cost-plus components.
: Koil secured its first subsea umbilical maintenance campaign in Brazil, covering re-termination and testing of umbilical elements.
: Formed a strategic partnership with Pipeline Network to expand international presence and customer support across the Eastern Hemisphere.
